column2: Find a ladder
I tracked down a ladder before stocking.
A case of eggs slips off your pallet.
Try to catch it
I caught a falling case of eggs!
I dropped 30 dozen eggs on the floor.
Let it fall and mop
A case of eggs smashed on the floor.
You find a shelf full of expired yogurt.
Pull and rotate everything
I pulled expired products and rotated stock.
Push them to the back
I hid expired yogurt at the back of the shelf.
A customer complained about expired yogurt I left out.
The new planogram says to move every cereal box three feet left.
Follow it exactly
I reset the cereal aisle to the new planogram.
Eyeball it
I eyeballed the new cereal layout.
My manager made me redo the cereal aisle.
Where Is It?
A customer asks where the toilet paper is for the third time today.
Walk them there
I walked a customer to the toilet paper aisle.
Point vaguely
I pointed vaguely toward the back of the store.
A package of cookies is already ripped open. They look delicious.
I ate a cookie from a damaged package.
I got caught eating damaged merchandise.
Mark it as damaged
I marked a damaged package correctly.
The walk-in freezer door slams shut behind you.
Use the emergency handle
I got stuck in the freezer but used the emergency release.
I was trapped in the freezer for 20 minutes.
{first} is stocking the same aisle and wants to race.
I beat {first} in a stocking race.
{first} beat me in a stocking race.
Work at my own pace
I declined a stocking race.
The overstock pile in the back is leaning dangerously.
Restack it safely
I fixed a dangerous overstock pile.
Walk past quickly
I walked past a leaning overstock pile.
The overstock pile collapsed on me.
The overnight stocking crew is short-staffed.
Cover the overnight
I covered an overnight stocking shift.
I turned down the overnight shift.
A juice box pallet is leaking sticky juice everywhere.
Clean it all up
Leave it for the next shift
I left a juice mess for the next shift.
The inventory app says there are 400 TVs in stock. There are 3.
Report the error
I reported a major inventory error.
I ignored a broken inventory count.
Toy Aisle Chaos
Kids have destroyed the toy aisle.
Rebuild it
I rebuilt the destroyed toy aisle.
Play with a toy first
I played with a remote control car in the toy aisle.
Your manager notices you stocked twice as much as anyone else.
Accept the praise
I was recognized as the fastest stocker.
A customer asks you to explain the difference between two nearly identical TVs.
Explain honestly
I helped a customer pick the right TV.
Push the expensive one
I upsold a customer to a pricier TV.
The customer returned the expensive TV I pushed.
The clothing tables look like a tornado hit them.
Fold everything perfectly
I refolded the entire clothing section.
Fold just the front
I folded the front of the clothing tables.
A customer wants you to price match a competitor's ad.
Check the policy
I handled a price match by the book.
Just give the discount
I gave a customer a discount without checking.
I got in trouble for an unapproved discount.
Credit Card Signups
Your manager wants five store credit card signups today.
Pitch every customer
I hit my store card signup goal.
I only got one credit card signup.
Skip the pitch
I skipped the credit card pitch.
Game Console Shortage
A parent begs you to find a sold-out game console for their kid's birthday.
Check every store nearby
I found a sold-out console for a customer's kid.
Say it's sold out
I told a parent the console was sold out.
A customer tries on 31 pairs of shoes and buys none.
Stay patient
I helped a customer try on 31 pairs of shoes.
Hide in the stockroom
I hid from a shoe-obsessed customer.
You're asked to make announcements over the intercom.
Use a radio DJ voice
I made the store announcements in a radio DJ voice.
My manager told me to stop doing the DJ voice.
Read it normally
I read the store announcements.
A customer asks if you can gift wrap a giant inflatable pool.
Give it a shot
I gift-wrapped an inflatable pool.
Explain we don't wrap
I told a customer we don't gift wrap.
You're setting up the Halloween section and a motion-activated skeleton screams at you.
A Halloween decoration scared me half to death.
I set up the Halloween section without flinching.
A customer needs help setting up their new phone.
Walk them through it
I helped a customer set up a new phone.
Point them to the manual
I pointed a customer to the phone manual.
A customer wants their bike assembled right now.
Build it on the spot
I assembled a bike for a customer.
The bike I assembled fell apart in the parking lot.
Schedule it for tomorrow
I scheduled a bike assembly.
Hundreds of clearance signs need to be put up before morning.
Stay late and finish
I stayed late to put up clearance signs.
Finish in the morning
I left the clearance signs for the morning.
Parents are fighting over the last packs of notebooks.
Restock from the back
I saved the day with backstock notebooks.
Let them fight
I watched parents fight over notebooks.
A customer asks if you can play the guitar on display.
Play a song
I played a song on a display guitar for a customer.
My manager told me to stop playing the display guitar.
I declined to play the display guitar.
You suspect the customer asking lots of questions is a corporate mystery shopper.
Give five-star service
I aced a corporate mystery shopper visit.
Treat them normally
I treated a mystery shopper like anyone else.
The only bananas left are brown and bruised.
Substitute with organic
I substituted bruised bananas with fresh organic ones.
Send the bruised ones
A customer complained about the bananas I picked.
Your handheld beeps: you're behind on pick rate.
I sped up to hit my pick rate.
I fell behind on my pick rate.
You open a carton to check the eggs. Two are cracked.
Swap the carton
I checked the eggs and swapped a cracked carton.
Send it anyway
A customer got cracked eggs from my order.
Your picking cart is overloaded and wobbling.
Stop and reorganize
I reorganized my overloaded cart.
I pushed an overloaded cart through the store.
My overloaded cart tipped over in the cereal aisle.
Frozen Food Timing
Your order has ice cream but the customer won't arrive for an hour.
Pick frozen items last
I timed frozen items perfectly.
Grab it now
The ice cream melted before pickup.
A customer at curbside says half their order is missing.
Run back and fix it
I fixed a curbside order on the spot.
Blame the system
I blamed the system for a missing order.
A customer hands you a $10 tip at curbside pickup.
A curbside customer tipped me $10.
Politely decline (policy)
I politely declined a tip per store policy.
The customer ordered a brand of tomato sauce that's out of stock.
Pick the closest match
I picked a great substitute for an out-of-stock item.
Mark it unavailable
I marked an item as unavailable.
A customer ordered 12 gallons of water and 40 cans of soup.
Lift it all
I hauled a massive grocery order.
Use a pallet jack
I used a pallet jack for a giant order.
Thanksgiving week: 300 pickup orders scheduled today.
Work through breaks
I picked orders through my breaks on Thanksgiving week.
Take my breaks
I took my breaks during the holiday rush.
The customer wrote "the good cheese" in the notes.
Pick the fancy brie
I picked fancy brie for a vague "good cheese" request.
The customer wanted cheddar, not brie.
Pick plain cheddar
I picked cheddar for a vague cheese request.
The customer wanted something fancier.
Your picking scanner dies with 40 items left.
Grab a spare
I swapped in a spare scanner.
Write items down by hand
I finished picking an order by hand.
An order contains 30 jars of pickles and a single banana.
Pick it, no questions
I picked an extremely weird grocery order.
Call to double-check
I double-checked a weird order with the customer.
You need to bag glass jars, bread, and bowling-ball-sized melons together.
Pack carefully
I packed a fragile order perfectly.
Toss it all in
A customer got squished bread from my order.
You had zero missing items for a whole week.
I had a perfect week of grocery picking.
Three associates called out sick on the same day.
Cover a shift myself
I covered a shift when my team called out.
Call people in on their day off
I called associates in on their day off.
Your department is 15% behind on monthly sales.
Plan a big promotion
My department promotion boosted sales.
My department promotion flopped.
Blame the weather
I blamed the weather for low sales.
{first} has been late five times this month.
Talk privately
I had a supportive talk with {first} about being late.
I wrote {first} up for being late.
Corporate is auditing your department's inventory tomorrow.
Prep all night
My department passed its inventory audit.
I winged the inventory audit.
My department failed its inventory audit.
You get to nominate one associate for an award.
I nominated {first} for an associate award.
Nominate myself somehow
I tried to nominate myself for an award.
Day Off Call
The store calls you on your day off with an "emergency."
I went to work on my day off for an emergency.
Let it ring
I ignored a work call on my day off.
You're told to cut your department's hours by 10%.
Cut my own hours first
I cut my own hours to protect my team.
Cut the newest hires
I cut hours for the newest associates.
{first} and another associate are refusing to work together.
Mediate a talk
I mediated a conflict between two associates.
Separate them
I split up two feuding associates.
Corporate sends a confusing 40-page policy update.
Read every page
I read a 40-page policy update.
Skim the summary
I skimmed a corporate policy update.
You're interviewing candidates for an open associate position.
Hire the experienced one
I hired an experienced associate.
Hire the enthusiastic one
I hired an enthusiastic new associate.
A furious customer demands to see "the manager." That's you.
Listen and resolve it
I calmed an angry customer and solved their problem.
Offer a gift card
I gave an angry customer a gift card.
Your department just had its best month ever.
Throw the team a pizza party
I threw my team a pizza party for a record month.
I took credit for my department's record month.
You spot an associate using a ladder unsafely.
Stop it immediately
I stopped an unsafe ladder situation.
Mention it later
I ignored an unsafe ladder.
An associate fell off a ladder on my watch.
The company offers you a leadership course.
I completed a leadership course.
I skipped the leadership course.
Store Manager Visit
The store manager is walking your department.
Show off improvements
I impressed the store manager during a walkthrough.
Point out problems
I honestly pointed out problems to the store manager.
The district manager is visiting your store tomorrow.
Rally the whole team
My store wowed the district manager.
The district manager found a messy stockroom.
Act like it's a normal day
I kept things normal for a district visit.
Your store missed its quarterly profit target.
Present a recovery plan
I presented a recovery plan for my store.
Blame the economy
I blamed the economy for my store's numbers.
A local news crew wants to film a story at your store.
Give a great interview
I was interviewed on the local news.
I declined a local news interview.
Corporate approved a full remodel of your store.
Oversee every detail
I oversaw a full store remodel.
Delegate it all
I delegated my store remodel.
Theft losses at your store doubled this year.
Hire more security
I cracked down on theft at my store.
Lock up more products
I locked up products to stop theft.
You can host a back-to-school supply drive.
Host it
My store hosted a back-to-school supply drive.
Skip it this year
I skipped the community supply drive.
You must promote either {first} or another strong associate to department manager.
Promote the other one
I passed over {first} for a promotion.
You need 40 seasonal workers before Black Friday.
Run a hiring event
I ran a seasonal hiring event.
Make the current staff work more
I made my staff cover the holiday rush.
A storm knocks out power to the entire store.
Keep customers calm and safe
I handled a storm power outage at my store.
Close early
I closed my store early during a power outage.
Your store hit every target this year. You earned a bonus!
Collect the bonus
I earned a $5,000 store manager bonus.
A video of a chaotic scene in your store is going viral.
Issue a public statement
I handled a viral video calmly.
A viral video from my store made headlines.
Corporate auditors arrive unannounced.
Welcome them in
My store passed a surprise corporate audit.
My store failed a surprise corporate audit.
Stall them
I tried to stall corporate auditors.
Corporate caught me stalling an audit. I was fired.
Associates delivered a petition asking for better breaks.
Meet with them
I met with associates about their petition.
Report it to corporate
I forwarded the petition to corporate.
Store of the Year
Your store was nominated for Store of the Year.
Push for the win
My store won Store of the Year!
My store came in second for Store of the Year.
I stayed humble about our nomination.
A rival retailer offers you a job with a bigger salary.
Stay loyal
I turned down a job offer from a competitor.
Use it to negotiate a raise
I negotiated a raise using a competitor's offer.
My bosses didn't like me shopping around.
being killed in an ambush
Your convoy rolls into a narrow valley in {country}. The lead truck stops. Then the ridgeline lights up with muzzle flashes.
Return fire from the turret
You poured fire into the ridge until the enemy broke contact.
Rounds sparked off your turret shield all around you.
Your driver floored it and the convoy punched out of the ambush.
A tire blew out and you were stuck in the kill zone.
Dismount and take cover
You found cover behind a rock wall and called in the coordinates.
The ditch you jumped into was in full view of a machine gun.
a sniper's bullet
A single crack echoes across the compound. The soldier next to you drops. There's a sniper somewhere in the buildings.
Drag him to cover
You dragged him behind a wall. He's going to make it.
Another shot kicked up dirt inches from your head.
Scan for the shooter
You spotted a glint in a window and your team silenced it.
You couldn't find him. He kept shooting.
Pop smoke first
The smoke screened you and you pulled him out.
The wind blew the smoke away in seconds.
stepping on a landmine
Your patrol takes a shortcut across an old field. Someone spots a rusted pressure plate. There could be more.
Probe the ground with your knife
You found three more mines and marked a safe lane.
Your hands were shaking so badly you had to stop.
Walk back exactly in your own footsteps
Step by step, everyone made it out.
Someone stepped wrong. The blast threw dirt everywhere.
Call in engineers and wait
The engineers cleared it. It took hours, but nobody got hurt.
You waited out in the open for hours. Not fun.
an IED blast
Your vehicle rolls over a culvert. Something under the road looks wrong.
The driver hit the brakes just in time. The bomb squad blew it in place.
Too late. The blast lifted the front of the truck off the ground.
Keep driving and hope
Nothing happened. Maybe it was just trash.
It detonated right under the engine block.
Reverse slowly out
You backed out in your own tire tracks.
A second device was buried behind you.
being shot during a night raid
Night vision goggles on. Your team stacks up outside a compound wall in {country}. Intelligence says a bomb maker is inside.
Be first through the door
You cleared the first room in seconds. Target captured.
Someone was waiting behind the door with a rifle.
Toss a flashbang first
The bang stunned everyone inside. Clean entry.
The flashbang bounced back off the doorframe.
Cover the windows from outside
You caught a runner trying to escape out the back.
Nobody came out your side. You saw nothing.
a mortar strike
The whistle of incoming rounds. Mortars are walking across your outpost.
You slid into the bunker as the ground shook.
A round landed close enough to knock you flat.
Get on the counter-battery radio
Your coordinates let artillery silence the mortar team.
The radio went down mid-transmission.
Hit the dirt where you are
You hugged the ground until it stopped.
Shrapnel tore through the tent next to you.
being shot on a rooftop
You're on a rooftop overwatch when enemy fighters start shooting from three directions.
Stand up and suppress them
Your fire pinned them down long enough for the squad to flank.
You were exposed for too long.
Crawl to the parapet and pick targets
Careful shots. Three fighters stopped shooting.
You couldn't get a clear shot.
Call for a gun truck
The truck rolled up and ended the fight.
The truck took twenty minutes to arrive.
a suicide bombing
At a checkpoint, a man in a heavy coat walks toward your position and won't stop.
Shout warnings and aim
He stopped, opened his coat. Just a jacket. You all breathed again.
He kept walking. The decision was made for you.
Fire a warning shot
He turned and ran. Later, they found a vest in an alley.
The shot didn't stop him.
Get everyone behind the barriers
When he detonated, the barriers took the blast.
Not everyone made it behind the barriers in time.
a helicopter crash
Your helicopter takes fire on approach. Warning tones fill the cabin and the pilot yells to brace.
A hard landing. Everyone crawled out alive.
The impact knocked you out for a few seconds.
Your fire kept their heads down as the pilot nursed it to the ground.
You were thrown across the cabin.
Strap in the wounded first
Everyone you strapped in survived the landing.
You didn't get yourself strapped in time.
drowning during a river crossing
The bridge is out. Your squad has to ford a fast river with full gear.
Cross first with the rope
You fixed the rope on the far bank. Everyone crossed safely.
Ditch the heavy gear first
Lighter, you crossed easily.
Your sergeant chewed you out for losing gear.
Find a shallower spot
A mile downstream, the water was knee-deep.
The detour got you lost.
Another unit mistakes your patrol for the enemy at night and opens fire.
Shout the challenge password
CEASE FIRE! They heard you just in time.
They couldn't hear you over the gunfire.
Fire an IR strobe
The strobe showed up in their night vision. They stopped.
Your strobe battery was dead.
Radio higher command
Command relayed the message. Shooting stopped.
The radio net was jammed with traffic.
a grenade blast
A grenade bounces into your position and rolls to a stop in the dirt.
Kick it away
It exploded outside the trench.
Your kick barely moved it.
Dive away and yell "GRENADE!"
Everyone hit the dirt. Only minor cuts.
The blast caught you mid-dive.
Throw it back
It exploded back in the enemy's position.
It was already cooking.
It's 120 degrees in {country}. You've been on patrol for nine hours with 80 pounds of gear. You stop sweating.
The medic iced you down. You were back on your feet in an hour.
You threw up everywhere, but you lived.
You made it back to base, barely.
You collapsed on the trail.
Drink all your water at once
It helped enough to get you home.
You ran out of water an hour later.
a rocket attack
INCOMING! Rockets slam into the base during dinner.
Get everyone in the dining hall down
Glass flew everywhere, but everyone was on the floor.
A rocket hit the roof.
Run for the bunker outside
You made the bunker.
A rocket landed in the open between you and the bunker.
Stay at the table
They all landed on the far side of base.
Bad call.
being killed clearing a cave
Fighters are hiding in a cave network in the mountains of {country}.
Lead the team inside
You cleared the cave and found a weapons cache.
A fighter opened up from the darkness.
Call in a bomb on the entrance
The airstrike sealed it.
The fighters escaped out a back exit.
Wait them out at the entrance
Hunger drove them out. They surrendered.
Night fell and they slipped away.
a vehicle rollover
Your armored truck slides off a crumbling mountain road and starts to tip.
Grab the gunner and pull him in
You yanked him down just before the truck rolled.
The truck rolled before you could get to him.
Brace against the roof
Bruised but alive.
You hit your head hard.
Bail out the door
You jumped clear.
You landed badly on the rocks.
crossfire
A child is lying in the street during a firefight, crying.
Run out and grab her
You scooped her up and ran. She's going to be okay.
Bullets cracked past you the whole way.
Ask for covering fire, then go
Your squad opened up and you got her out.
The covering fire came a second too late.
Hold your position
A local man ran out and pulled her to safety.
You round a corner in a narrow alley and come face to face with an enemy fighter.
Fire first
You were faster.
You both fired.
Duck back around the corner
You ducked back and your buddy covered the corner.
He followed you around the corner.
Charge him
You tackled him before he could raise his weapon.
He was stronger than he looked.
a booby trap
Searching an abandoned house, you notice a thin wire across a doorway.
Cut the wire
Nothing happened. You found a grenade on the other end.
It was a decoy. The real trap was on the floor.
Mark it and back out
EOD came and disarmed it.
Someone else tripped it later that week.
Step over it
You stepped over carefully and kept searching.
Your boot caught it.
Drone Strike Gone Wrong
an enemy drone strike
You hear a buzzing overhead. An enemy drone is circling your trench.
Shoot it down
Your rifle fire knocked it out of the sky.
You missed. It dropped its grenade.
Run for the dugout
It lost you under the cover.
It followed you.
Freeze and stay still
It didn't see you and flew off.
It saw you.
The ground shakes. Enemy artillery is zeroing in on your trench line.
Move to the next trench
You moved just before the next salvo hit your old spot.
The shells followed you.
Stay low in your foxhole
The shells landed short.
A shell landed right on the lip of the hole.
Help dig out a buried friend
You dug him out alive.
The next shell landed close.
Wounded Behind Enemy Lines
being killed behind enemy lines
Your squad is cut off. The radio is smashed and enemy fighters are searching the area.
You blasted a path through and reached friendly lines.
You ran straight into their main force.
Hide until dark
They walked right past you. You slipped out at night.
A dog found you.
Signal aircraft with a mirror
A helicopter spotted the flash and came for you.
The enemy saw the flash too.
being killed when the outpost was overrun
At dawn, hundreds of fighters assault your small outpost from every side.
Man the machine gun
You held the line until air support arrived.
They focused all their fire on your position.
Hand out ammo to the line
Without you, they would have run dry.
You were caught in the open running ammo.
Call in danger-close air support
The bombs landed meters from the wire and broke the attack.
Some of the bombs landed too close.
a severe infection
Half your platoon has a fever after drinking local water.
Report to the medic right away
Antibiotics fixed it in a few days.
You were in the aid station for a week.
You sweated it out.
It got much worse.
Steal the medic's good meds
It worked, but your sergeant found out.
You took the wrong pills.
being killed during a hostage rescue
Insurgents are holding aid workers in a farmhouse. You're on the rescue team.
Breach the front door
Every hostage came out alive.
The front door was rigged.
Go through a window
You caught the guards by surprise.
You got stuck in the window frame.
Negotiate from outside
They let the hostages go.
Talks broke down.
a chemical attack
The chemical alarm goes off. "GAS! GAS! GAS!"
Mask up in nine seconds
Your mask sealed perfectly.
Your mask had a crack in it.
Help a buddy mask up first
You both got your masks on.
You breathed in some of it.
Run upwind
You got clear of the cloud.
The wind changed.
a demolition accident
You need to blow a bridge before enemy tanks cross it.
Set the charges under fire
The bridge dropped into the river right before the tanks arrived.
A tank shell hit the bridge while you were under it.
Use a long time fuse
It worked, with time to spare.
The fuse burned too fast.
Call in an airstrike instead
The jets took the bridge out.
The jets were delayed. The tanks crossed.
POW Camp Escape
being shot trying to escape
You've been captured. Guards are distracted and a fence is loose.
You squeezed through and ran into the night.
A searchlight swung toward you.
Wait for a better chance
A rescue raid freed you two days later.
They moved you somewhere more secure.
Help others escape first
Four men got out because of you.
The guards noticed the commotion.
being shot while loading a medevac
A medevac helicopter lands in a hot zone. You have to load three wounded soldiers.
Carry them one by one
All three got on the bird.
Rounds were hitting the helicopter as you ran.
Cover the loading team
Your fire kept the enemy down.
You ran out of ammo.
Wave the pilot off until it's safer
The pilot came back after air support.
One of the wounded didn't make it.
being killed in a tank battle
Enemy armor rolls over the ridge. Your unit has anti-tank weapons and seconds to act.
Fire the anti-tank missile
Direct hit. The lead tank burst into flames.
The backblast gave away your position.
Relocate to a better angle
You hit it in the side armor.
You got spotted moving.
Call artillery on the ridge
The artillery broke up their attack.
The artillery was too slow.
Weeks of combat catch up with you. Your heart races and you can't breathe during a quiet guard shift.
He took your watch and talked you through it. You're not alone.
He didn't understand.
Keep it to yourself
It passed. You never told anyone.
It happened again the next night.
The chaplain helped more than you expected.
It helped a little.
Mail call. There's a letter with your name on it.
Read it right away
Good news from home. You read it ten times.
Bad news. You read it ten times anyway.
Save it for a hard day
You opened it after a bad patrol. Perfect timing.
It got soaked in a rainstorm.
Write back first
Your letters crossed in the mail. Your family loved it.
You never found the right words.
getting lost in a sandstorm
A massive sandstorm hits while your patrol is in the open desert. You can't see your hand.
Hold onto the man in front of you
The squad stayed together and waited it out.
Navigate by compass
You got everyone back to the trucks.
You walked in a circle for hours.
Keep moving toward base
You found the gate.
You wandered off alone.
an insider attack
A local soldier you've trained for months suddenly turns his rifle on your group.
You took him down before he could fire again.
He was already firing.
You were out of his line of fire.
He fired at you.
Shoot back
You stopped him.
You both fired at once.
falling from a mountain pass
Your patrol moves along a narrow mountain path at night. Enemy fire starts from above.
Return fire up the slope
You pinned them down until help came.
You lost your footing.
Hug the cliff wall
They couldn't get an angle on you.
Rocks rained down on you.
Run for the next bend
You made it around the bend.
The path crumbled under you.
being killed in a snatch mission
Your team is sent to capture a high-value target from a moving car.
Box the car in
Perfect box. Target captured.
The car rammed your vehicle.
Shoot out the tires
The car skidded to a stop.
The guards came out shooting.
Follow and wait for the stop
They stopped for gas. Easy grab.
You lost the car in traffic.
a secondary explosion
A market bombing. Dozens of wounded civilians. And a second bomb may be waiting.
Run in and treat the wounded
You saved several lives.
A second blast went off.
Set up a safe perimeter first
You found and cleared a second device first.
It took too long. People suffered.
Direct civilians away
You got hundreds of people clear.
The crowd panicked.
You haven't slept in three days. You catch yourself nodding off on guard duty.
Wake up a buddy to cover
He covered for you. You owe him.
He was asleep too.
Drink four energy drinks
You were wide awake. Too awake.
Your heart was pounding all night.
Pinch yourself awake
You fell asleep. The sergeant found you.
walking into a trap
You arrive at a "quiet" village from the intel report. It's too quiet.
Push into the village
The village was clear. Intel was right.
It was a trap.
Send a drone first
The drone spotted fighters waiting. You called it in.
The drone missed them.
Set up and watch
Fighters gave themselves away after an hour.
You wasted the whole day.
Fuel Depot Fire
burns from a fuel fire
An attack sets the base fuel depot on fire. Someone is trapped near the tanks.
Run in for him
You dragged him out seconds before a tank exploded.
A tank exploded.
Grab the fire extinguisher
You beat back the flames long enough.
The extinguisher was empty.
Call the fire crew
The fire crew got him out.
It took them too long.
Wild Dog Pack
A pack of feral dogs surrounds your patrol at night.
They scattered.
One of them bit your leg.
Stay calm and back away
They lost interest.
They followed you for a mile.
Throw them your rations
They loved you. One followed you back to base.
Now you're hungry.
being killed while pinned down
A machine gun nest pins your squad behind a low wall. The wall is starting to crumble.
Flank it alone
You crept around and silenced the gun.
The gunner swung toward you.
